caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bowl with an off-white or light beige body. The bowl features a thin golden or yellow band around the rim and a detailed blue decorative motif on the side, which appears to be a landscape scene with trees, a bridge or structure, and other natural elements. The main view of the bowl is centered within a lightly drawn rectangular frame. Below the main image, there is a smaller technical drawing of the same bowl, shown in elevation with the same decorative motif. This smaller drawing is labeled with precise measurements: 6 inches in width across the rim, 3 1/2 inches in height, and 3 1/2 inches across the base; it is noted as being at a 1/4 scale. The entire composition is rendered in soft, muted tones, primarily light beige, blue, and yellow, on a plain background.
title: Bowl
